ns2:course.label: Algebraic Combinatorics
ns2:course.description: Prepares students for research in modern algebraic combinatorics by focusing on its three principal components: enumerative techniques, symmetric functions, and multivariate polynomials. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: MATH 580 or consent of instructor.
